specs-o.esr_esl_dc_bias_source-s: Würth Elektronik LTspice model library WCAP-ATG8.lib (rev22a, 6/1/2022, eiSos EDA Service; github.com/WurthElektronik/LTspice-Library sub/WCAP-ATG8.lib, the repository Würth's LTspice user guide UG002 names), subckt 860010683032_4.7mF: Rser 0.015 ohm, Lser 9.7 nH, C 4.7 mF, Rpar 21277 ohm -> esr_mohm = Rser (frequency-independent model, so also the ESR at SRF), esl_ph = Lser, srf_mhz = 1/(2 pi sqrt(Lser C)). Model values, not a measured curve; temperature not stated. Würth datasheet 860010683032 rev 1.0 (2014-11-11): ripple 3355 mA max (120 Hz, 85 degC); DF 10 % typ (120 Hz); leakage 2350 µA max; load life 2000 h at 85 degC; no impedance stated. DC bias not applicable (electrolytic). Read 2026-10-27

component-o.description-s: 4700 µF ±20% 50 V aluminum electrolytic capacitor, WCAP-ATG8 (general purpose, 85 °C 2000 h), radial can 22.0 x 41.0 mm, 10.0 mm lead pitch, 0.8 mm leads
